Name: (AT or CP) Paper Plane Tractor or Horse
Author: Tunkaa
Description:
[font=Tahoma][quote]
在完成第一个虎鲸坐骑以后，我又寻思着再画一个

这一次想起了纸飞机

于是纸飞机坐骑诞生啦

画得很开心

希望大家也能够喜欢

（本来打算多来几个颜色，但这件事情先等等，也许以后会有新颜色？）

After completing the first killer whale mount, I thought about creating another one.

This time, I thought of a paper plane.

And thus, the Paper Plane mount was born!

I had a lot of fun drawing it, and I hope you'll like it too.

(I originally planned to use more colors, but let's wait for a bit on that. Maybe there will be new colors in the future?)[/quote][/font]
